description: Search Illinois Compiled Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "currency exchange license fee", "concealed carry reciprocity", "landlord retaliation". Returns ranked sections with their citations; use il_compiled_statute afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "currency exchange license fee".

name: il_statute_search
title: Il Statute Search
